architecture.mechanism: machine learning with state-of-the-art ML interpretability
architecture.intervention: Deploy an automated system combining machine learning and interpretability artifacts to analyze vehicle starting system data streams, identifying patterns of unauthorized activation attempts and generating actionable insights to update immobilizer logic in real-time.
architecture.expected_effect: Rapid and robust scientific insight enabling complex knowledge discovery from data to prevent engine activation when the key is removed, matching or exceeding prior predictive performance for theft prevention.
architecture.falsification_test: Compare the false negative rate of unauthorized engine activations in vehicles using the new interpretable ML-based immobilizer against a control group using standard static immobilizers over a 12-month field trial.
